proof_summary: Take \(n=18\): \(\sigma(18)=39\), so its reduced denominator is \(18/\gcd(18,39)=6\), while \(\sigma(6)=12\), so the corresponding denominator for \(6\) is \(1=2^0\). Hence the required property holds after applying the map to \(18\), but not for \(18\) itself, since \(6\) is divisible by \(3\) and therefore is not a power of \(2\).
